name: Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs + Broccoli & Couscous
steps: Pat chicken thighs dry and season generously with salt, pepper, half the lemon juice, and herbs.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5-6 min until golden. Flip and sear 3 min.
Toss broccoli with remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Arrange around chicken.
Transfer skillet to 400°F oven. Bake 20-25 min until chicken reaches 165°F internal.
Meanwhile, bring broth and remaining lemon juice to a boil. Stir in couscous, cover, and let sit 5 min. Fluff with fork.
Serve chicken and broccoli over couscous. Drizzle with pan juices and garnish with lemon zest.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Snap Peas & Brown Rice
steps: Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and 2 tbsp water in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry chicken 4-5 min until cooked through. Remove.
Add snap peas and bell pepper. Stir-fry 3-4 min until tender-crisp.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return chicken to wok. Pour sauce over and toss to coat, 1-2 min.
Serve over brown rice. Garnish with green onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Greek Yogurt Chicken Skewers + Greek Salad
ingredients: 1½ lbs chicken breast, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
steps: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil, salt, and pepper. Toss chicken cubes in marinade. Refrigerate at least 30 min (or overnight).
Thread chicken onto skewers (soak wooden skewers 30 min first).
Grill or broil skewers 12-14 min, turning occasionally, until cooked through (165°F).
Meanwhile, combine cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl. Dress with vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper.
Serve skewers over or alongside the Greek salad. Pita bread optional.

name: Honey-Garlic Chicken & Veggie Sheet Pan
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large sheet pan with parchment.
Toss potatoes and carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on sheet pan and roast 10 min.
Meanwhile, whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, vinegar, and red pepper flakes.
Add chicken and broccoli to the pan. Drizzle honey-garlic sauce over everything.
Roast 20-25 min until chicken is 165°F and vegetables are tender.
Spoon pan juices over chicken before serving.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
ingredients: 1½ lbs chicken breast, sliced into strips
Salsa, sour cream, avocado for topping
steps: Toss chicken strips with chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook chicken 5-6 min until browned. Remove.
Add remaining oil, peppers, and onion. Sauté 5-6 min until charred edges appear.
Return chicken to pan, toss with vegetables.
Serve over rice with cheese, salsa, sour cream, avocado, and lime wedges.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
steps: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger to make teriyaki sauce.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 6-8 min until golden.
Pour teriyaki sauce over chicken. Simmer 3-4 min until sauce thickens (add cornstarch slurry at the end).
Divide rice into bowls. Top with teriyaki chicken.
Garnish with edamame, julienned carrot, sesame seeds, and sriracha if desired.

name: Chicken Parmesan with Zucchini Noodles
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, pounded to ½-inch thick
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Set up breading station: egg in one dish, panko mixed with Parmesan and Italian seasoning in another.
Salt and pepper chicken. Dip in egg, then breadcrumb mixture, pressing to coat.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in oven-safe skillet. Bread chicken 3 min per side until golden.
Top each breast with marinara and mozzarella. Bake 12-15 min until cheese is bubbly.
Meanwhile, sauté zucchini noodles in remaining oil 2-3 min (don't overcook). Season with salt.
Serve chicken over zoodles. Garnish with fresh basil.

name: Thai Peanut Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook ground chicken 6-8 min, breaking up, until no pink remains.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, honey, and sriracha with 2 tbsp warm water. Pour over chicken.
Toss to coat and cook 2 min until sauce thickens slightly.
Spoon chicken mixture into lettuce cups. Top with shredded carrot, peanuts, cilantro, and lime juice.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Toss chicken with taco seasoning and a pinch of salt. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 6-8 min, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and slightly charred.
Warm black beans and corn in a small saucepan or microwave.
Assemble bowls: rice base, then chicken, beans, corn, pico de gallo, cheese, sour cream, and avocado.
Squeeze lime over top. Add hot sauce if desired.

name: Chicken & White Bean Soup with Kale
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) white beans, drained
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Sear 4 min per side. Remove and set aside.
Add onion, carrot, and celery. Sauté 5 min until softened. Add garlic and thyme, cook 1 min.
Add broth, white beans, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce to simmer.
Return chicken to pot. Simmer 15-20 min until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, return to pot. Stir in kale and lemon juice. Cook 3 min until kale wilts.
Remove bay leaf. Adjust seasoning. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken + Sun-Dried Tomatoes
steps: Season chicken with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken 5-6 min per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In same skillet, add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Sauté 1 min.
Pour in broth and heavy cream. Stir, scraping up browned bits. Simmer 3-4 min.
Stir in spinach and Parmesan. Cook 2 min until spinach wilts and sauce thickens.
Return chicken to skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken. Garnish with basil. Serve over pasta or rice.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Thighs + Olives
ingredients: ½ cup dry white wine or chicken broth
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat chicken thighs dry, season with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet. Sear chicken skin-side down 5-6 min until deeply golden. Flip and sear 3 min. Remove.
Add onion and tomatoes to the pan. Cook 3-4 min until tomatoes start to burst.
Add garlic, olives, and capers. Pour in wine/broth and lemon juice.
Return chicken to pan, skin-side up. Transfer to oven. Bake 20-25 min.
Garnish with fresh oregano. Serve with crusty bread or couscous.

name: Turkey Taco Bowls
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ground turkey, breaking it up. Cook 6-8 min until no pink remains. Drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and ¼ cup water. Stir and simmer 3 min.
Assemble bowls: rice, seasoned turkey, black beans, cheese, salsa, sour cream, lettuce, and avocado.
Serve with lime wedges and tortilla chips on the side.

name: Turkey Bolognese + Whole Wheat Pasta
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 5 min until soft.
Add garlic, cook 1 min. Push vegetables to the side, add ground turkey, breaking it up. Cook 6-8 min.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes, broth, oregano, and basil. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer uncovered 20-25 min, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Serve sauce over pasta. Top with grated Parmesan.

name: Turkey Meatball Sub Bites
ingredients: 6 sub rolls or hot dog buns
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Combine ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix gently.
Form into small meatballs (about 1-inch diameter). Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake 18-20 min until cooked through (165°F internal).
Warm marinara sauce in a saucepan. Toss meatballs in sauce.
Split rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce. Top with mozzarella.
Place under broiler 2-3 min until cheese melts. Garnish with basil.

name: Turkey & Sweet Potato Chili
ingredients: Shredded cheese, sour cream for topping
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook turkey 6-8 min, breaking up. Drain fat.
Add onion, cook 3 min. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika. Stir 1 min.
Add sweet potatoes, diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 25-30 min until sweet potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with shredded cheese and sour cream.

name: Asian Turkey Lettuce Cups
steps: Heat sesame oil in a wok or skillet over high heat. Add turkey, breaking up. Cook 6-8 min.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min. Add water chestnuts.
Stir in hoisin, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Cook 2-3 min until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat. Stir in green onions.
Spoon into lettuce cups. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sriracha if desired.

name: Turkey Pesto Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 6 bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place peppers cut-side up in a baking dish.
Cook turkey in a skillet 6-8 min. Add garlic, cook 1 min. Add diced tomatoes.
Combine turkey mixture with cooked rice, ½ cup pesto, and breadcrumbs. Season with salt and pepper.
Stuff mixture into peppers. Top with mozzarella and a drizzle of remaining pesto.
Cover with foil and bake 25 min. Remove foil, bake 5 more min until cheese is golden.
Garnish with Parmesan and fresh basil before serving.

name: Sheet-Pan Salmon + Asparagus + Sweet Potato
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan and roast 10 min.
Toss asparagus with 1 tbsp oil. Season salmon with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Push sweet potatoes to one side. Add salmon and asparagus to the pan. Scatter garlic and lemon slices.
Roast 12-15 min until salmon flakes with a fork (145°F) and sweet potatoes are tender.
Drizzle with remaining lemon oil. Garnish with fresh dill.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Place salmon in a shallow dish. Pour teriyaki sauce over and marinate 10-15 min.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook salmon skin-side up 4 min. Flip and cook 3-4 more min.
Meanwhile, divide rice into bowls.
Top rice with salmon (break into chunks), avocado, cucumber, and pickled ginger.
Drizzle with remaining teriyaki sauce, sesame seeds, and sriracha mayo. Garnish with green onions.

name: Cajun Salmon Tacos + Mango Salsa
steps: Combine mango, red onion, jalapeño, lime juice, and cilantro for salsa. Season with salt. Set aside.
Rub salmon with Cajun seasoning. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook salmon 4-5 min per side until cooked through. Break into large chunks.
Warm tortillas. Fill with cabbage, salmon, mango salsa, and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve with lime wedges.

name: Lemon-Dill Salmon + Cucumber-Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: Rice or crusty bread for serving
steps: Combine grated cucumber, yogurt, garlic, half the dill, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Stir and refrigerate.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, and lemon zest. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook salmon 5-6 min per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve salmon over rice or bread, topped with cucumber-yogurt sauce, capers, and remaining dill.
Squeeze extra lemon juice over the top.

name: Cilantro-Lime Salmon + Black Bean Rice
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and warmed
steps: Mix lime juice, cilantro, chili powder, cumin, and olive oil. Rub over salmon. Let sit 10 min.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Cook salmon 4-5 min per side.
Stir half the cilantro-lime mixture into the warm rice. Fold in black beans.
Serve salmon over cilantro-lime black bean rice. Top with avocado and extra cilantro.
Add hot sauce if desired.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod + Tomatoes & Olives
ingredients: ½ cup white wine or broth
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place cod fillets in a baking dish. Season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Scatter tomatoes, olives, garlic, and capers around and over the fish.
Drizzle everything with olive oil. Pour wine/broduct into the dish.
Bake 18-22 min until cod flakes easily.
Garnish with fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread to soak up the juices.

name: Tuna Poke Bowls
steps: Toss cubed tuna with soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and sriracha. Let marinate 10 min.
Divide rice into bowls.
Arrange tuna, avocado, cucumber, and edamame on top of rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds, nori strips, and pickled ginger.
Serve with wasabi and extra soy sauce on the side.

name: Pesto Crusted Tilapia + Roasted Vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss vegetables with 2 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan.
Mix pesto with panko. Spread mixture on top of each tilapia fillet.
Nestle fish into the vegetables on the sheet pan. Drizzle with remaining oil.
Roast 18-20 min until fish is opaque and crust is golden.
Squeeze lemon over everything. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

name: Beef & Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 6 bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
Sour cream and cilantro for topping
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place peppers cut-side up in a baking dish.
Brown ground beef in a skillet 6-8 min. Drain fat. Add garlic, cumin, and chili powder.
Stir in black beans, rice, corn, and half the diced tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Stuff mixture into peppers. Top with remaining tomatoes and shredded cheese.
Cover with foil. Bake 25 min. Remove foil, bake 5 more min until cheese is bubbly.
Top with sour cream and cilantro.

name: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes.
Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat 6-8 min, breaking up. Drain fat.
Pour sauce over beef. Stir and simmer 3-4 min until slightly caramelized.
Divide rice into bowls. Top with beef, carrots, and broccoli.
Garnish with green onions, sesame seeds, and a fried egg if desired.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb flank steak, sliced thin against the grain
steps: Toss sliced beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch. Let sit 10 min.
Mix remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and brown sugar. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry beef 3-4 min until browned. Remove.
Add broccoli, stir-fry 3-4 min. Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 sec.
Return beef to wok. Pour sauce over. Toss 1-2 min until glossy.
Serve over rice. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Zucchini Noodle Bolognese
steps: Heat oil in a large pot. Sauté onion and carrot 5 min. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add ground beef, breaking up. Cook 6-8 min until browned. Drain fat.
Stir in tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, and basil. Season well.
Simmer 20-25 min until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Sauté zucchini noodles in a separate pan 2-3 min (don't overcook).
Serve sauce over zoodles. Top with Parmesan.

name: Mexican Beef Burrito Bowls
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook ground beef 6-8 min, breaking up. Drain fat.
Add taco seasoning and ¼ cup water. Simmer 3 min.
Assemble bowls: rice, seasoned beef, beans, corn, cheese, pico, sour cream, guacamole, and lettuce.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce.

name: Shepherd's Pie with Cauliflower Topping
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, steamed and mashed
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Brown beef in an oven-safe skillet 6-8 min. Drain fat.
Add onion and carrots, cook 5 min. Add garlic, peas, broth, tomato paste, and Worcestershire.
Simmer 10 min until slightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix steamed cauliflower with butter, salt, and pepper. Spread over beef mixture.
Top with cheddar. Bake 20-25 min until golden and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh thyme.

name: Beef Kofta Kebabs + Tzatziki
ingredients: Lettuce, tomato, red onion for serving
steps: Combine ground beef, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Form into oval-shaped kebabs around skewers (soak wooden skewers first).
Grill or broil 12-15 min, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Mix yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice, dill, salt for tzatziki.
Serve kofta in pita with tzatziki, lettuce, tomato, and red onion.

name: Chili con Carne
ingredients: Shredded cheese, sour cream, green onions for topping
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Brown beef 6-8 min. Drain fat.
Add onion and bell pepper. Cook 5 min. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika. Stir 1 min.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30-35 min, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with cheese, sour cream, and green onions.

name: Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 6 bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place peppers cut-side up in a baking dish.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Sauté onion and sliced pepper 5 min until softened.
Add steak slices, garlic powder, and a splash of Worcestershire. Cook 4-5 min until browned.
Divide steak mixture among peppers. Top each with a slice of provolone.
Cover with foil. Bake 20 min. Remove foil, bake 5 more min until cheese is melted and golden.

name: Beef Picadillo Rice Bowls
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook beef 6-8 min, breaking up. Drain fat.
Add onion and bell pepper. Cook 5 min. Add garlic, cumin, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, raisins, olives, and capers. Stir well.
Simmer 10-15 min until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice. Garnish with cilantro and hot sauce.

name: Pasta e Fagioli (Sausage & White Bean Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb Italian sausage (mild or hot), casings removed
steps: Heat oil in a large pot. Crumble sausage into pot. Cook 6-8 min until browned. Remove excess fat if needed.
Add onion, carrot, and celery. Cook 5 min. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta. Simmer 12-15 min until pasta is tender.
Stir in spinach. Cook 2 min until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with grated Parmesan and crusty bread.

name: Honey-Garlic Pork Chops + Green Beans
steps: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and vinegar.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops 4-5 min per side until golden and 145°F internal. Remove.
Add butter and honey-soy mixture to the pan. Simmer 2 min. Return chops to pan, coat in glaze.
Meanwhile, sauté green beans in remaining oil 5-6 min until tender-crisp. Season with salt.
Serve pork chops over green beans. Drizzle with extra glaze. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Pork Carnitas Tacos
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
steps: Season pork with salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, and oregano.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sear pork on all sides until browned, about 8 min total.
Add garlic, orange juice, and lime juice. Add water to come halfway up the pork.
Cover and braise at 300°F for 2.5-3 hours until fork-tender.
Shred pork. Spread on a sheet pan and broil 5-7 min until edges are crispy.
Serve in warm tortillas with onion, cilantro, salsa verde, sour cream, and lime.

name: Sausage & Sheet-Pan Vegetables + Mustard Sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes and onion with 2 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 10 min.
Add sausages and broccoli to the pan. Drizzle with remaining oil. Roast 15-18 min.
Whisk Dijon, whole grain mustard, honey, and vinegar for the sauce.
Serve sausages and vegetables with mustard sauce drizzled on top. Garnish with thyme.

name: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Toss diced pork with 1 tbsp soy sauce. Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Cook pork 4-5 min until browned. Push to one side.
Scramble eggs on the other side of the wok. Break into small pieces.
Add rice, breaking up clumps. Stir-fry 3-4 min until heated through.
Add peas, carrots, garlic, remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss 2 min.
Stir in green onions. Season with white pepper. Serve hot.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Hoagies
steps: Grill or pan-fry sausages 12-15 min, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet. Sauté peppers and onion 8-10 min until soft and slightly charred.
Add marinara sauce to the peppers. Simmer 3 min. Season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Split hoagies, add sausage, top with pepper mixture and provolone.
Optional: place under broiler 2 min to melt cheese.

name: Pulled Pork Sliders + Coleslaw
steps: Rub pork with brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Place in slow cooker. Add ½ cup BBQ sauce and ½ cup water.
Cook on low 8 hours (or high 4-5 hours) until fork-tender.
Shred pork. Mix with remaining BBQ sauce.
Toss coleslaw mix with mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Pile pulled pork on slider buns. Top with coleslaw and pickles.

name: Pork & Bok Choy Stir-Fry
steps: Toss pork slices with cornstarch. Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry pork 4-5 min until browned. Remove.
Add bok choy and mushrooms. Stir-fry 3-4 min. Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 sec.
Return pork to wok. Pour sauce over. Toss 1-2 min until glossy.
Serve over rice. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Tacos
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
½ cup crumbled cotija or feta
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato with oil, cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a sheet pan. Roast 20-25 min, flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized.
Warm black beans in a small saucepan. Lightly mash half of them.
Warm tortillas. Fill with sweet potatoes, black beans, cheese, avocado, and cilantro.
Serve with hot sauce and lime wedges.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat coconut oil in a large pot. Sauté onion 5 min. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric, and cumin. Stir 1 min.
Add diced tomatoes and coconut milk. Bring to a simmer.
Add chickpeas. Simmer 15 min until sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in spinach. Cook 2-3 min until wilted. Season with salt.
Serve over rice with fresh cilantro. Naan bread on the side.

name: Lentil Bolognese + Whole Wheat Pasta
steps: Cook lentils according to package directions. Drain.
Heat oil in a large pot. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 5 min. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add tomato paste, stir 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes, cooked lentils, oregano, basil, and bay leaf.
Simmer 20-25 min until thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf.
Cook pasta according to package. Drain. Serve sauce over pasta with Parmesan.

name: Bean & Cheese Enchilada Bake
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz) pinto beans, drained and mashed
Sour cream, cilantro, sliced jalapeños for topping
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Mix mashed beans with corn, green chiles, cumin, and ½ cup cheese.
Spread ¼ cup enchilada sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with bean mixture, roll up, and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Cover with foil. Bake 20 min. Remove foil, bake 10 more min until bubbly.
Top with sour cream, cilantro, and jalapeños.

name: Tofu Pad Thai
ingredients: 14 oz extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
3 tbsp fish sauce (or soy sauce for vegan)
steps: Soak rice noodles in hot water 10 min until pliable. Drain.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind, sugar, and vinegar for the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Fry tofu cubes 5-6 min until golden on all sides. Remove.
Add garlic, cook 30 sec. Push to side, scramble eggs on the other side.
Add noodles and sauce. Toss 2-3 min until noodles absorb sauce.
Add bean sprouts and green onions. Toss 1 min. Top with crushed peanuts, lime, and sriracha.

name: Quinoa-Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove stems from mushrooms, scrape out gills. Brush with oil, season with salt and pepper.
Mix quinoa, sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, pine nuts, pesto, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Fill each mushroom cap with quinoa mixture. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Place on a baking sheet. Bake 20-25 min until mushrooms are tender and cheese is golden.
Garnish with fresh basil and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
